play.name: Third Shot Drive
play.description: Pressure the kitchen team with a low drive and prepare for another ball.

steps.label: Starting Positions
steps.description: Green prepares to serve while Orange sets a returner deep and a partner at the kitchen.

steps.label: Diagonal Serve
steps.description: Serve deep into the opposite service box. The serve must bounce before the return.

steps.label: Deep Return and Advance
steps.description: Return deep, then move toward the kitchen. Green stays back and lets the return bounce.

steps.label: Third Shot Drive
steps.description: Green drives low at the established kitchen team, advancing only into transition.

steps.label: Compact Fourth-Shot Block
steps.description: Orange volleys the drive with a compact block. Green remains balanced for the next ball.

play.name: Lob & Overhead
play.description: Lift a defensive lob, then see the overhead reply before a bounce.

steps.label: Draw Them Forward
steps.description: Serve and return have already bounced. Green is ready to lift over an Orange player leaning toward the kitchen.

steps.label: Forehand Lob
steps.description: Green sends a high forehand lob over the kitchen player.

steps.label: Overhead Reply
steps.description: Orange turns, gets behind the ball, and strikes an overhead before it bounces.
